extra-1bd6bc9c8ec4.zh-Hans:
高品质动画影像。高密度3D卡通／赛璐璐风格电影级动作RPG的高速剑戟。剧场版级别的关键动画、优质合成、通透感照明、高密度背景美术。8秒短片，将浮游刀的猛攻、防御、闪避、反作用力、包围、最大冲突高密度地连接起来。

【参考图像与人物固定】
@1是第一位、角色A的参考图像。
@2是第二位、角色B的参考图像。
参照源参考图像中的角色，分别维持为同一个人物。参考图像仅用于角色的脸、眼型、虹膜颜色、发型、发色、服装、装饰、体格、剪影、氛围、角色主色、武器设计。不重现参考图像本身的背景、房间、家具、姿势、画角、构图、文字、分割布局。
两人全篇分别为same person、same character identity。仅表情、视线、嘴角、姿态、呼吸、自然的头发与服装摆动可以变化。不产生特征混合、脸部平均化、发色互换、服装互换、武器互换、体格变化、变成他人、克隆化、分身、追加人物。

【世界观与舞台的自动调整】
战斗内容、位置关系、动作、力量关系、刀数、镜头结构固定。仅背景、小道具、建筑样式、地板材质、天气、照明、色调、粒子、环境特效，根据@1与@2的角色设计重新设计。

从两人的服装、装饰、武器、材质、纹样、固有色彩、主题中，全新构建一个两人能够自然存在其中的电影级战斗舞台。从学园都市、宫殿、神殿、庭园、幻想都市、工业设施、近未来空间等中选择最合适的舞台。但不直接复制参考图像的背景。

地板上配置反射、水滴、沙尘、雪、花瓣、火星、魔力粒子等适合世界观的接触表现。栏杆、柱子、玻璃、树木、机械结构、魔法装置、发光线条等小道具仅使用适合舞台的。背景比人物暗一档，使脸、剪影、刀的轨迹清晰。
将角色A的固有色彩用于攻击侧的主光、浮游刀的光环、斩击残光。将角色B的固有色彩用于防御光、反击残光、辅助光。两者颜色不混合，保持可明确识别的状态。

【画风固定】
纤细细腻的彩色轮廓线。脸、头发、服装、武器采用明快的二段至三段赛璐璐阴影与通透的中间影。瞳孔为多层高光，头发为细腻的束感，服装高密度地描绘刺绣、蕾丝、装甲、锁链、宝石、金属件等参考图像中存在的细节。

布、皮革、金属、宝石、玻璃、地板以不同的反射率与粗糙度区分描绘。不做粗黑轮廓、平坦单层赛璐璐阴影、简化TV动画、通用3D美少女脸、塑料CG、低密度背景、半写实、实拍、暗淡色彩、画风混合。不复制参考图像的画风，统一为高密度3D卡通／赛璐璐风格。

【武器固定】
角色A使用手持刀一把，以及身体周围漂浮的四把浮游刀。浮游刀配置为包围A的上、下、左、右。角色B使用手持刀一把。整个影像的刀固定为合计六把。

即使参考图像的武器不是刀，也重新设计为继承该武器的颜色、材质、设计、装饰、主题的刀。
浮游刀是刀身、护手、刀柄相连的完整一把刀。仅在攻击时以明确的飞行轨迹移动，接触或闪避后返回A的周围。不进行增殖、消失、融合、变形、追加多余刀。不让刀尖或刀身单独独立旋转。手持刀只握刀柄，不用手抓刀身。

【浮游刀特效】
四把浮游刀缠绕以角色A的固有色彩为主的淡薄火焰状、雾状、粒子状、电光状光环。表现形式配合A的世界观，但必须紧贴刀身。向移动方向拖出短尾，不做巨大的独立激光或单独的光线。斩击残光作为紧贴刀扫过面的弯曲残光产生。

【力量关系】
角色A是冷静掌握主导权的上位者。以时间差操控四把浮游刀，同时自己也以手持刀前进。角色B以高超剑技弹开、闪避、拨开猛攻，尝试反击，但因攻击方向连续变化而逐渐被压制。维持仅A前进、仅B后退的非对称移动。
【镜头】
不使用固定横视点，而使用穿过浮游刀的斜低角度、B的越肩、接触点的近距离、以接触点为轴约60度的环绕、逼近最终冲突的斜低空镜头。将浮游刀从镜头前通过、环境粒子、从地板弹起的水沫、刀光用作短暂的遮挡转场。不让镜头与背景旋转、让人物无意义地旋转。

【8秒的动作构成】
Cut 1：
从四把浮游刀静止于A的上下左右的状态开始。镜头以穿过两把浮游刀之间的斜低角度，展示A的脸、上半身、装饰、手持刀。A静静前进，仅以视线捕捉B。紧接着，右上方的浮游刀加速，斜向飞向B的左肩口。

Cut 2：
B的越肩。B以双手刀在刀身中央之间的单一接触点将第一把浮游刀向外弹开。产生金属火花、两者的固有色彩魔力火花、环境粒子、反作用力。被弹开的刀划出弧线返回A的周围。接着左下方的第二把贴着地板掠过，B低身以毫厘之差闪避。左上方的第三把从斜上方降下，B翻转刀身拨开。

Cut 3：
从环境粒子的遮挡中以斜前方映出A。A不停步地踏进，以手持刀从右下向左上斩上。B一边后退一边接住。两把手持刀在一点接触的瞬间，右下方的浮游刀从B的侧面侵入。B缩肩闪避，但姿势向横向偏移。A滑开接触解除，进一步进入内侧。
Cut 4：
以接触点为中心镜头环绕约60度。B利用反作用力放出回斩，但A的一把浮游刀从侧面接触，将B的刀向上拨开。A将手持刀从左上向右下挥下。B急忙接住，但脚下打滑被向后推。剩余三把浮游刀向B的左右与上方散开，形成压缩退路的包围构图。

Cut 5：
斜低空镜头。左前方前进的A，右深处被逼入的B。B作为最后的反击踏进。A也不停止前进，从左下向右上放出上升斩。两把手持刀在中央的单一接触点形成清晰的X字。一把浮游刀从侧面向B的刀身施加追加压力，剩余三把在周围摆出下一次斩击的姿势。
A的攻击色与B的防御色分别升起，在中心狭窄的白热核外侧形成巨大的双色X字色面。放射状冲击波、环境粒子、蒸汽、火花扩散。B的后脚打滑，膝盖下沉，双臂与肩的防御线开始崩溃。A保持低重心向前传递力量。X字的发光扩大至最大，在B的防御开始崩溃的瞬间立即切镜。战斗继续。

【重大NG】
禁止固定横向的格斗游戏视点、左右对称的全身构图、镜像的同时冲刺、长距离助跑、长时间的刀剑相抵、无意义的连续旋转。刀固定为A的手持一把＋浮游四把、B的一把，合计六把。禁止浮游刀的增殖、消失、融合、变形、贯穿身体、仅刀尖独立旋转。不用手抓刀身。无独立激光、第三道光线、双色融合、全画面白屏。无追加人物、文字、字幕、标志、水印、UI、音响生成。
extra-1bd6bc9c8ec4.en:
High-quality anime footage. Cinematic action RPG high-speed sword fighting in high-density 3D toon/cel-look. Theatrical-film-class key animation, high-quality compositing, translucent lighting, high-density background art. In an 8-second short, densely connect the fierce onslaught of floating swords, defense, evasion, reaction force, encirclement, and maximum clash.

[Reference images and character fixation]
@1 is the reference image for the first person, Character A.
@2 is the reference image for the second person, Character B.
Refer to the characters in the source reference images and maintain each as the same person. Use the reference images only for the character's face, eye shape, iris color, hairstyle, hair color, costume, ornaments, physique, silhouette, atmosphere, character color, and weapon design. Do not reproduce the reference images' own backgrounds, rooms, furniture, poses, angles of view, framing, text, or split layouts.
The two are throughout the entire piece each the same person, same character identity. Only expressions, gazes, mouth corners, posture, breathing, and natural swaying of hair and costume may change. Do not cause feature mixing, face averaging, hair color swapping, costume swapping, weapon swapping, physique changes, becoming different people, cloning, doppelgangers, or additional people.

[Automatic adjustment of world view and setting]
Combat content, positional relationships, actions, power relationships, number of swords, and camera structure are fixed. Only the background, props, architectural style, floor material, weather, lighting, color tone, particles, and environmental effects are redesigned to match the character designs of @1 and @2.
From the two characters' costumes, ornaments, weapons, materials, patterns, inherent colors, and motifs, newly construct a single cinematic combat stage where both can naturally exist. Select the optimal stage from academy city, palace, temple, garden, fantasy city, industrial facility, near-future space, etc. However, do not directly copy the backgrounds of the reference images.
On the floor, place contact expressions suited to the world view, such as reflections, water droplets, dust, snow, petals, sparks, and magic particles. Use only props suited to the stage, such as railings, pillars, glass, trees, mechanical structures, magical devices, and glowing lines. Make the background one step darker than the characters to make faces, silhouettes, and sword trajectories clear.
Use Character A's inherent color for the attacker's key light, the floating swords' aura, and slash afterglow. Use Character B's inherent color for defensive light, counterattack afterglow, and auxiliary light. Do not mix the two colors; keep them clearly distinguishable.

[Art style fixation]
Thin, delicate colored outlines. Clear two- to three-stage cel shading and translucent intermediate shadows on faces, hair, costumes, and weapons. Eyes with multilayer highlights, hair with delicate bundle definition, costumes with embroidery, lace, armor, chains, jewels, metal fittings, and other details present in the reference images drawn at high density.
Draw cloth, leather, metal, jewels, glass, and floor with different reflectivity and roughness. Do not use thick black outlines, flat single-layer cel shadows, simplified TV anime, generic 3D beautiful-girl faces, plastic CG, low-density backgrounds, semi-realism, live action, dull colors, or mixed art styles. Do not copy the art style of the reference images; unify to high-density 3D toon/cel-look.

[Weapon fixation]
Character A uses one held sword and four floating swords that hover around the body. The floating swords are positioned surrounding A above, below, left, and right. Character B uses one held sword. The total number of swords in the entire video is fixed at six.
Even if the weapon in the reference image is not a sword, redesign it into a sword that inherits that weapon's color, material, design, ornaments, and motifs.
A floating sword is a complete single sword with blade, guard, and hilt connected. It moves with a clear flight trajectory only when attacking, and after contact or evasion returns to around A. Do not multiply, disappear, fuse, transform, or add extra swords. Do not independently rotate only the tip or blade. For held swords, grip only the hilt; do not grab the blade with the hand.

[Floating sword effects]
The four floating swords are wrapped in a thin flame-like, mist-like, particle-like, or lightning-like aura centered on Character A's inherent color. The expression format matches A's world view, but must adhere closely to the blade. Draw a short tail in the direction of movement; do not make giant independent lasers or separate light rays. Slash afterglow occurs as a curved afterglow adhering to the sword's sweep plane.

[Power relationship]
Character A is the calmly dominant superior. While manipulating the four floating swords with staggered timing, A also advances with the held sword. Character B deflects, evades, parries, and attempts counterattacks against the fierce onslaught with high swordsmanship, but is gradually pushed back because the attack directions change continuously. Maintain asymmetric movement where only A advances and only B retreats.
[Camera]
Do not use a fixed side view; use an oblique low angle through the floating swords, over B's shoulder, close range at the contact point, an approximately 60-degree orbit around the contact point, and an oblique low-altitude camera closing in on the final clash. Use floating swords passing in front of the lens, environmental particles, splashes bouncing off the floor, and sword light as short occlusion wipes. Rotate the camera and background; do not rotate the characters meaninglessly.

[8-second action structure]
Cut 1:
Start from a state where the four floating swords are stationary above, below, left, and right of A. The camera passes between two floating swords at an oblique low angle, showing A's face, upper body, ornaments, and held sword. A quietly advances and captures B with only a gaze. Immediately after, the upper-right floating sword accelerates and flies diagonally toward B's left shoulder.

Cut 2:
Over B's shoulder. B deflects the first floating sword outward with the two-handed sword at a single contact point between blade centers. Metal sparks, magic sparks of both characters' inherent colors, environmental particles, and reaction force occur. The deflected sword draws an arc and returns to around A. Next, the second sword from the lower left runs just above the floor, and B sinks low and evades by a hair's breadth. The third sword from the upper left descends diagonally from above, and B turns the sword and parries.

Cut 3:
From an occlusion by environmental particles, show A at an oblique front. A does not stop, steps in, and slashes up with the held sword from lower right to upper left. B receives it while retreating. At the instant the two held swords contact at a single point, the lower-right floating sword intrudes from B's side. B pulls the shoulder back and evades, but the posture flows sideways. A slides the contact to release it and enters further into close range.
Cut 4:
The camera orbits approximately 60 degrees around the contact point. B uses the reaction force to unleash a return slash, but one of A's floating swords contacts from the side and deflects B's sword upward. A swings the held sword down from upper left to lower right. B hurriedly receives it, but the footing slips and B is pushed backward. The remaining three floating swords spread to B's left, right, and above, creating an encircling composition that narrows the escape route.

Cut 5:
Oblique low-altitude camera. A advancing in the left foreground, B being pushed into the right background. B steps in for a final counterattack. A also does not stop advancing and unleashes a rising slash from lower left to upper right. The two held swords form a clear X shape at a single contact point in the center. One floating sword applies additional pressure to B's blade from the side, and the remaining three take the next slashing stance around them.
A's attack color and B's defense color rise separately, forming a giant two-color X-shaped color plane outside the narrow white-hot core at the center. Radial shockwaves, environmental particles, steam, and sparks spread. B's rear foot slips, the knee sinks, and the defensive line of both arms and shoulders begins to collapse. A keeps a low center of gravity and drives force forward. The X-shaped glow expands to maximum, and cut immediately at the instant B's defense begins to collapse. Combat continues.

[Major NG]
Fixed side-view fighting-game perspective, left-right symmetric full-body composition, mirrored simultaneous dashes, long run-ups, long blade locks, and meaningless continuous spinning are prohibited. Swords are fixed at A's one held + four floating, B's one, total six. Multiplication, disappearance, fusion, transformation, piercing the body, and independent rotation of only the tip of floating swords are prohibited. Do not grip the blade with the hand. No independent lasers, third light rays, two-color fusion, or full-screen whiteout. No additional people, text, subtitles, logos, watermarks, UI, or sound generation.

extra-eb2bdede007e.zh-Hans:
STYLE
超写实电影级冒险，实拍品质，大片级制作，照片级真实，无缝视觉转场，扎实的物理，自然日光，HDR，沉浸式叙事。

CHARACTER
一位英俊的年轻成年男性，深色短发，运动型体格，身穿黑色夹克内搭灰色T恤、深色牛仔裤和运动鞋。自然的面部表情与可信的反应。

CAMERA
使用ARRI Alexa 65搭配变形镜头拍摄。平滑的电影级跟拍、航拍镜头运动、真实运动模糊、浅景深、无缝转场。

LIGHTING
明亮的自然日光，物理准确的阳光，真实的阴影与大气雾霭。

TIMELINE

0.0–4.0s | Scene 1
真实生活般的写实风格，自然光照，男子站在高楼的屋顶上俯瞰繁忙的现代城市。一个巨大的发光次元传送门突然在他前方屋顶之外的天空中打开。镜头平滑地绕到他身后，转为越肩视角。出于好奇，他开始朝那神秘现象跑去。当他接近时，重力突然改变，将他从屋顶抬起并拉入传送门。他立即进入穿过无尽天空的连续高速自由落体。他的表情从好奇变为彻底的震惊。4.0–8.0s | Scene 2，仍在坠落，身体动作真实、与风的交互准确，一个发光的传送门出现在他下方。他顺畅地穿过它，毫无中断。瞬间，整个环境转变为充满活力的动画城市。建筑、街道、车辆、人物，甚至角色本身都变成高品质动画，同时保留他的发型、面部特征和服装设计。他一边继续自然坠落，一边惊讶地看着自己动画化的双手和服装。另一个发光传送门出现在下方。
8.0–12.0s | Scene 3
他以一个无缝动作穿过下一个传送门。世界瞬间转变为细节丰富的体素风格宇宙，有方块搭建的城市、道路、树木、云朵、车辆和人物。他的外观变为同样的体素风格，同时保持完全相同的服装和比例。他继续以可信的物理坠落，检查自己变化后的身体，然后发现下方另一个传送门。
12.0–16.0s | Scene 4
穿过下一个传送门，一切转变为写实的未来科幻大都市，拥有先进建筑、悬浮车辆、全息显示和尖端科技。他的服装自然变为与环境相配的流线型高科技套装，脸和手仍可见为同一角色。他仍在连续坠落，难以置信地看着自己的未来感手套和套装，同时下方形成另一个发光传送门。
16.0–20.0s | Scene 5
他以一个完美平滑的转场进入最后的传送门。环境转变为美丽的柔和粉彩色世界，有柔和梦幻的光照、优雅的建筑、色彩缤纷的树木和宁静的环境。他原本的休闲服装回归，并以同样的粉彩艺术风格重新构想。他仍在自然坠落，惊讶地看着自己的双手、服装和周围环境，而每个世界的生活都照常继续，对他的旅程一无所知。序列以他继续朝充满活力的景观下降结束。
DIRECTOR NOTES
在整个序列中保持一次连续的自由落体，具备准确的重力、动量和自然的身体动作。每次传送门转场都应流畅，无剪切或视觉跳跃。每个世界都应在角色周围瞬间转变，同时保持连续性。角色的外观应适应每个世界的风格，同时保持一眼可辨。优先电影级写实、可信的反应和无缝的世界转场。
